import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long MAX_VAL = 1000000000L;
    static long inputNumber;
    static long[] baseNumbers = new long[18];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        inputNumber = sc.nextLong();

        baseNumbers[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            baseNumbers[i] = baseNumbers[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }

        System.out.println(recursiveCalculation(inputNumber, 17));
        sc.close();
    }

    static long recursiveCalculation(long m, int idx) {
        long currentSum = (m / baseNumbers[idx]) * (idx + 1);
        m %= baseNumbers[idx];
        if (m == 0) return currentSum;
        return currentSum + Math.min((long)(idx + 1) + recursiveCalculation(baseNumbers[idx] - m, idx - 1),
                                      recursiveCalculation(m, idx - 1));
    }
}
